name: strings and numbers
sql: select * from users where email = 'ada@example.com' and id = 42
redacted: select * from users where email = 's' and id = 0

name: like keeps the wildcard shape
sql: select * from products where name like '%lamp%' or sku like 'AB%'
redacted: select * from products where name like '%s%' or sku like 's%'

name: limit and offset keep their values
sql: select id from orders where total > 99.90 limit 20 offset 50000
redacted: select id from orders where total > 0 limit 20 offset 50000

name: escaped quotes
sql: update notes set body = 'it\'s a ''secret''' where id = 7
redacted: update notes set body = 's' where id = 0

name: identifiers with digits untouched
sql: select t1.col2 from table3 t1 where t1.x = 5
redacted: select t1.col2 from table3 t1 where t1.x = 0

name: in list
sql: select * from logs where entity_id in (4848337, 4848338)
redacted: select * from logs where entity_id in (0, 0)

name: postgres placeholders are not values
sql: select id from products where description ilike $1 and price > 10 limit $2
redacted: select id from products where description ilike $1 and price > 0 limit $2
